# widgetlint

> Validator, linter and optimizer for Telegram Bot API 10.4 widgets: catches everything the client silently strips and everything the server refuses, before sending.

## Rule reference

- [TGW001 — raw HTML exceeds 32768 bytes](docs/rules/TGW001.md): raw HTML exceeds 32768 bytes
- [TGW002 — compressed size exceeds 4096 bytes](docs/rules/TGW002.md): compressed size exceeds 4096 bytes
- [TGW003 — compressed size exceeds the soft budget](docs/rules/TGW003.md): compressed size exceeds the soft budget
- [TGW004 — invalid UTF-8 or a NUL character in the input](docs/rules/TGW004.md): invalid UTF-8 or a NUL character in the input
- [TGW005 — compressed size is within 64 bytes of the hard limit](docs/rules/TGW005.md): compressed size is within 64 bytes of the hard limit
- [TGW100 — form controls are removed together with their content](docs/rules/TGW100.md): form controls are removed together with their content
- [TGW101 — form/label degrade to plain boxes; form semantics do not work](docs/rules/TGW101.md): form/label degrade to plain boxes; form semantics do not work
- [TGW102 — media and embedding elements are removed](docs/rules/TGW102.md): media and embedding elements are removed
- [TGW103 — service elements are removed](docs/rules/TGW103.md): service elements are removed
- [TGW104 — external <script src> never executes](docs/rules/TGW104.md): external <script src> never executes
- [TGW105 — <img> not from a data: URL shows a placeholder](docs/rules/TGW105.md): <img> not from a data: URL shows a placeholder
- [TGW106 — data: image uses an unsupported type](docs/rules/TGW106.md): data: image uses an unsupported type
- [TGW108 — legacy presentational element or attribute](docs/rules/TGW108.md): legacy presentational element or attribute
- [TGW109 — unsupported interactive attribute](docs/rules/TGW109.md): unsupported interactive attribute
- [TGW110 — unknown element will render as an inline box](docs/rules/TGW110.md): unknown element will render as an inline box
- [TGW111 — <a href> with a scheme other than https: or #fragment is ignored](docs/rules/TGW111.md): <a href> with a scheme other than https: or #fragment is ignored
- [TGW113 — aria-* attributes are kept but have no effect](docs/rules/TGW113.md): aria-* attributes are kept but have no effect
- [TGW114 — element implies text input or focus, but there is no keyboard](docs/rules/TGW114.md): element implies text input or focus, but there is no keyboard
- [TGW150 — unsupported SVG element](docs/rules/TGW150.md): unsupported SVG element
- [TGW200 — viewport height units are unsupported](docs/rules/TGW200.md): viewport height units are unsupported
- [TGW201 — overflow auto/scroll is rewritten to hidden](docs/rules/TGW201.md): overflow auto/scroll is rewritten to hidden
- [TGW202 — position sticky is rewritten to relative](docs/rules/TGW202.md): position sticky is rewritten to relative
- [TGW203 — logical properties are unsupported](docs/rules/TGW203.md): logical properties are unsupported
- [TGW204 — multi-column layout is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW204.md): multi-column layout is unsupported
- [TGW205 — this display value is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW205.md): this display value is unsupported
- [TGW206 — 3D transforms are unsupported](docs/rules/TGW206.md): 3D transforms are unsupported
- [TGW207 — this filter function is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW207.md): this filter function is unsupported
- [TGW208 — clipping, masking and blending are unsupported](docs/rules/TGW208.md): clipping, masking and blending are unsupported
- [TGW209 — this text effect is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW209.md): this text effect is unsupported
- [TGW210 — modern color function is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW210.md): modern color function is unsupported
- [TGW211 — env()/url() argument is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW211.md): env()/url() argument is unsupported
- [TGW212 — this at-rule or nested CSS is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW212.md): this at-rule or nested CSS is unsupported
- [TGW213 — this selector pseudo-class is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW213.md): this selector pseudo-class is unsupported
- [TGW214 — this @media feature is unsupported](docs/rules/TGW214.md): this @media feature is unsupported
- [TGW215 — named font families are not available](docs/rules/TGW215.md): named font families are not available
- [TGW216 — property is not recognized by the CSS engine](docs/rules/TGW216.md): property is not recognized by the CSS engine
- [TGW300 — more than 400 CSS rules](docs/rules/TGW300.md): more than 400 CSS rules
- [TGW301 — more than 32 @keyframes rules](docs/rules/TGW301.md): more than 32 @keyframes rules
- [TGW302 — attribute or inline style longer than 8 K UTF-16 units](docs/rules/TGW302.md): attribute or inline style longer than 8 K UTF-16 units
- [TGW303 — more than 2000 DOM nodes](docs/rules/TGW303.md): more than 2000 DOM nodes
- [TGW304 — text value over 32 K UTF-16 units or document over 48 K](docs/rules/TGW304.md): text value over 32 K UTF-16 units or document over 48 K
- [TGW400 — network APIs are disabled in widgets](docs/rules/TGW400.md): network APIs are disabled in widgets
- [TGW401 — navigation APIs do not work in widgets](docs/rules/TGW401.md): navigation APIs do not work in widgets
- [TGW402 — dialogs are unavailable in widgets](docs/rules/TGW402.md): dialogs are unavailable in widgets
- [TGW403 — this navigator API is unavailable in widgets](docs/rules/TGW403.md): this navigator API is unavailable in widgets
- [TGW404 — this DOM or file API is unavailable in widgets](docs/rules/TGW404.md): this DOM or file API is unavailable in widgets
- [TGW405 — focus/blur/select do nothing in widgets](docs/rules/TGW405.md): focus/blur/select do nothing in widgets
- [TGW406 — this canvas feature is outside the profile](docs/rules/TGW406.md): this canvas feature is outside the profile
- [TGW408 — TelegramWidget.sendMessage does not exist](docs/rules/TGW408.md): TelegramWidget.sendMessage does not exist
- [TGW411 — deprecated TelegramWidget theme alias](docs/rules/TGW411.md): deprecated TelegramWidget theme alias
